verdict.rationale: Orb documents alerts that fire at usage thresholds, an alert endpoint for customer credit balances, real-time webhooks, and tracking of accrued revenue before invoices. That covers the threshold-and-alert half of the story and part of the accrued-cost half. There is no evidence of a customer-facing view of current-cycle usage and cost, or of a real-time in-cycle usage dashboard for the team; the accrued-revenue claim reads as internal finance tracking. Missing for 10: a customer-facing usage/cost portal, explicit real-time current-cycle usage and accrued-cost visibility, cost-based (not only usage or credit) threshold alerts, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone

citations.quote: Trigger alerts at usage thresholds to power product-led growth.
This endpoint creates a new alert to monitor a customer's credit balance.
Orb provides a powerful, real-time webhooks system that can issue calls to an endpoint of your choosing when certain events take place.
